assessment_scope: Formal scoped Design Review, round 1, of VAL-SR-25, VAL-DEC-08, Validation token-cost feature retirement and associated acceptance/displacement clauses; Engineering token-cost retirement; Packaging and Release token-cost qualification removal; Skill evidence/proportional-effort token paragraph; and their source/consumer interactions. Full five model members were read for context. Upstream direction is proposal-review-design-basis plus the directly authorized full-retirement decision design-token-cost-feature-retirement. This is one bounded affected package, not approval of the accumulated whole-repository cleanup or unrelated pending model changes.
independence_basis: Separate delegated agent /root/token_retirement_design_review independently inspected the authored package and actual consumers. The parent/design author supplied the models; this reviewer did not edit any reviewed model or implement the retirement.
limitations: Approval covers only the selected token-cost retirement responsibilities and their interactions; unrelated source retirement, local-mirror changes, historical replay withdrawal, scheduling adoption and broader model conformance are not approved by this review.

The exact implementation inventory and commands remain Delivery work. In particular, include record-store-interactions.mjs tokenization, record-store-tokenize.py and its documentation/selector consumers while retaining independent interaction and CLI output protection.

This review did not execute implementation tests, modify model members, approve a delivery plan, establish implementation correctness, complete the cleanup, perform final Verify, or authorize publication. Historical Proposal Review subjects are not retargeted; only its unchanged cleanup direction is relied on, supplemented by the recorded explicit user retirement decision.
rationale: The explicitly authorized direction retires the inconclusive feature entirely rather than retaining optional measurement or introducing a replacement metric. VAL-SR-25 and VAL-DEC-08 preserve that decision, rationale, rejected alternative and consequences; the Skill, Engineering, Packaging and Release sections consistently delegate to this owner. Current evidence sufficiency, conditional loading, scope fidelity and truthful runtime observations remain intact.

The design distinguishes token counting/session/report-schema functionality, whose dedicated tests may retire, from independently useful source safety, CLI result shape/omissions/truncation/output bounds, privacy and candidate integrity. Its required retained proof has observable negative boundaries rather than a test-count or historical-report-existence oracle. Inspection confirms the CLI byte wrapper already refuses execution; its frozen baseline is not current CLI correctness proof.

Actual adapter_distribution.py dynamically loads the token-report parser for benchmark qualification and appends the version-specific token_cost_report requirement; release-verify.sh likewise invokes the report validator for v0.1.1. The selected producer/consumer slice explicitly removes these imports, branches, metadata expectations and callers while preserving source/profile/version/artifact identity, side-effect boundaries and malformed candidate rejection. No fake pass or historical approval reinterpretation is permitted.

Actual selectors route token tools, report paths, fixtures and CLI measurement checks. The design requires deleted paths still reach affected retained protection without launching removed IDs and preserves closed-vocabulary rejection. Actual shared helpers must be evaluated by retained callers, not filename; the record-store-interactions tokenization branch/helper is an additional concrete allocation item under this complete feature-retirement scope while interaction semantics remain supported.

The existing responsibility graphs and necessary context/building-block/runtime/deployment views remain adequate: retirement removes qualification and measurement dependencies from existing catalog, package and release boundaries rather than introducing a component or changing public-write authority. Representative acceptance requires a valid candidate without reports, invalid candidate rejection, retained output/source-safety boundaries and no benchmark-driven agent execution or report writes through retained entrypoints.

Compatibility and recovery are explicit: no compatibility stub reports successful measurement; retired report obligations and M4 duties are superseded; historical judgments keep original bytes and identities; live reliance and uncommitted content are reconciled before deletion; failed removal restores its coherent producer/consumer/fixture slice. Delivery must name concrete edits and checks, with reviewed implementation and successful Verify before adoption.
summary: The bounded token-cost feature retirement Design is coherent and sufficient for its scoped Delivery allocation.
